headword: {皆既|かいき}{日食|にっしょく}

definitions.explanation: A solar eclipse in which the Moon completely covers the Sun, briefly revealing the corona and darkening the sky.

examples.japanese: {皆既|かいき}{日食|にっしょく}を{見|み}た。
examples.english: I saw a total solar eclipse.

examples.japanese: {次|つぎ}の{皆既|かいき}{日食|にっしょく}は{何年後|なんねんご}ですか。
examples.english: How many years until the next total solar eclipse?

examples.japanese: {皆既|かいき}{日食|にっしょく}の{間|あいだ}、{昼|ひる}なのに{空|そら}が{暗|くら}くなった。
examples.english: During the total solar eclipse, the sky grew dark even though it was daytime.

notes:
Composed of {皆既|かいき} (total; complete) + {日食|にっしょく} (solar eclipse).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {皆既|かいき}{日食|にっしょく}を{観測|かんそく}する: to observe a total solar eclipse
- {皆既|かいき}{日食|にっしょく}が{起|お}こる: a total solar eclipse occurs

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {金環|きんかん}{日食|にっしょく}: annular eclipse — a ring of sunlight remains around the Moon
- {部分|ぶぶん}{日食|にっしょく}: partial eclipse — only part of the Sun is hidden
